2609.09158.title: TANGO: Humanoid Navigation in Cluttered Environments with a Whole-Body Vision-Language-Action Model
2609.09158.paper_summary: We study the problem of navigating cluttered indoor environments with a humanoid robot. Unlike conventional methods that model navigation as a 2D path planning problem, humanoid traversal in cluttered environments requires continuous geometry-aware whole-body adaptation, including coordinated arm placement, torso adjustment, and gait modulation for collision-free movement through complex 3D spaces. We introduce TANGO, the first whole-body vision-language navigation framework for language-conditioned humanoid traversal in cluttered environments. Given a natural-language instruction and egocentric RGB observations, TANGO directly predicts 29-DoF joint-space actions for downstream whole-body control. We train TANGO entirely in simulation by synthesizing diverse collision-free traversal behaviors via global path planning, kinematic whole-body motion generation, obstacle-aware motion editing, and RL-based tracking. This pipeline provides dynamically feasible action supervision for learning language-conditioned whole-body policies. In extensive simulation experiments, TANGO demonstrates state-of-the-art performance in vision-language navigation, while outperforming strong modular baselines in navigating challenging scenes requiring obstacle negotiation. Lastly, we deploy TANGO zero-shot on a Unitree G1 humanoid robot, and observe robust language-guided traversal in cluttered real-world scenes without training on any real-world navigation data.
2609.09158.paper_summary_zh: 我們研究使用人形機器人在雜亂的室內環境中導航的問題。與將導航建模為2D路徑規劃問題的傳統方法不同，人形機器人在雜亂環境中的行進需要持續的幾何感知全身適應，包括協調的手臂放置、軀幹調整和步態調節，以便在複雜的3D空間中實現無碰撞的移動。我們介紹了TANGO，首個針對語言條件下人形機器人在雜亂環境中行進的全身視覺-語言導航框架。給定自然語言指令和自我中心的RGB觀察，TANGO直接預測29自由度的關節空間動作，以便進行下游的全身控制。我們完全在模擬中訓練TANGO，通過全球路徑規劃、運動學全身運動生成、障礙物感知運動編輯和基於增強學習的跟踪合成多樣的無碰撞行進行為。這個流程為學習語言條件的全身策略提供了動態可行的行動監督。在廣泛的模擬實驗中，TANGO在視覺-語言導航中展示了最先進的性能，同時在導航需要障礙物協商的挑戰場景中超越了強大的模塊基準。最後，我們在Unitree G1人形機器人上零次訓練部署TANGO，觀察到在雜亂的真實場景中進行穩健的語言引導行進，而不需要在任何真實世界導航數據上進行訓練。
